Package com.robojacks.lib.command

Class Command

java.lang.Object
com.robojacks.lib.command.Command
Direct Known Subclasses:
ArcadeDrive, ArcadeDrive, ConditionalCommand, DeferredCommand, DriveDistance, DriveToPoint, FeedforwardCharacterization, FollowTrajectory, FunctionalCommand, ParallelCommandGroup, ParallelDeadlineGroup, ParallelRaceGroup, SequentialCommandGroup, TankDrive, TankDrive, TurnAutoTune, TurnToHeading, WaitCommand, WaitUntilCommand
public abstract class Command extends Object
Base class for commands. Lifecycle and decorators match WPILib: initialize -> execute (every loop) -> isFinished? -> end(interrupted).
